findings.message: 2 tl.fromTo() calls target "#s2code" with no stable baseline. The last-authored fromTo "from" values become the element's resting state for any seek before the first tween actually runs, because GSAP applies fromTo from-values at authoring time (immediateRender), not at tween position.
findings.fixHint: Add `immediateRender: false` to every fromTo except the earliest-positioned one (at 3.5999999999999996s), so pre-first-tween seeks keep its "from" values. A hiding `tl.set(..., 0)` baseline trips gsap_timeline_set_initial_hide, and a `gsap.set` authored before the fromTo calls is overwritten by them.

findings.message: This HTML file has 19 timed elements. Smaller sub-compositions keep timelines easier to read, iterate on, and diff.
findings.fixHint: Move coherent scene groups into separate .html files under compositions/ and mount them from the parent with data-composition-src so the timeline stays easier to inspect, revise, and validate.
